Bring the physical link down when the interface is down by placing the PHY
in power-down state
column2: unless WOL is enabled.  This mirrors the behavior of

column1: other drivers including e1000 and tg3.
Without the patch
column2: ifconfig down leaves the physical link up

column1: datacenter users who expect the link lights both on the NIC and the switch to
go out when they bring an interface down.
Furthermore
column2: even though the phy is powered on

column1: so a normally gigabit link might suddenly become 100 Mbit half-duplex when the
interface goes down
column2: and become gigabit when it comes up again.

column1: Ayaz said:
I would not include this patch until further testing is performed.  NVIDIA
MCP chips use 3rd party PHY vendors.  By powering down the phy
have adverse affects on certain phys.
Arthur Jones said:
I just ran across this patch.  Tested on a Marvell 88E1121R (GigE PHY)
and works great.  This is a very important feature for me.
